summary:
Comprehensive architectural refactoring and performance optimization plan for the Azure Boards mobile workspace:
- Isolates the two-stage detail bottom sheet gesture physics onto layout/draw phases (Modifier.offset lambda & graphicsLayer) to eliminate frame-by-frame Compose recompositions during dragging and settling.
- Fixes upper-zone swipe-to-dismiss reliability when the detail sheet is fully expanded so downward swipes in the upper 1/4–1/3 of the screen smoothly drag and close the sheet completely while lower-zone touches stay locked to content scrolling.
- Deconstructs monolithic UI views into modular, state-isolated subcomponents (Header & Title Editor, Metadata & Classification Bar, Description Editor, Tags Row, Parent & Children Hierarchy Cards, Discussion & Mention Composer, and Shared Picker Dialogs).
- Eliminates keystroke-level global list mutations and disk snapshot thrashing by keeping draft text state local to the active editor and debouncing global state/repository updates.
- Separates board list state from detail sheet state and offloads @mention people indexing to background flows so typing, scrolling, and sheet transitions run at a locked 60/120fps.
